title: Send to Trillion opens lighter
summary: Every page of the Send to Trillion browser extension now carries only what it uses: the popup, Mark up, Attach files and the reply window are half the size or less, and nothing in them talks to anything but Trillion.

payload.title: Same extension, less to load
payload.body: Send to Trillion 1.3.1 works exactly as before: sign in, add the page, attach files, mark up a picture, reply to a notice. Each page now loads less than half of what it did (the popup 0.88 MB, was 1.97 MB), and a page that grows past its limit can no longer be built.
